children.text: Deals 25% damage when KOed by contact damage.
Raises the power of all moves by 30% if the wielder moves last.
Raises Attack to +6 if struck by a critical hit.
Alerts the wielder to certain dangerous moves.
Prevents grounded Pokemon from switching. Increases encounter rate.
User recovers half the HP inflicted on opponent.
Stronger when the user does not have a held item.
Gives target priority in the next turn.
